limitations: Runtime source validation and evidence retrieval do not establish model answer correctness or semantic abstention.
Final holdout Q23/Q24 absent-label defects remain documented and are not counted as passed absence tests.
The 3x ratio covers note-owned allocated tables/indexes on this fixture, not whole messages.db, WAL/SHM or long-run growth.
Process-cold reopen timings do not flush the OS cache; measurements are local fixture results.
Independent reviews and exact citation regressions cover accepted safety invariants; tests do not establish OS confinement against privileged writers.
Installation, restart and a real-workspace smoke test require separate authorisation.
